name: unsafe fn write_volatile < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
rule: If `size_of::<T>()` is nonzero, the entire `size_of::<T>()`-byte range starting at `dst` must lie within the allocated object determined by `dst`'s provenance; this is necessary but not always sufficient for validity. Each stack-allocated variable is a separate allocated object.
api: unsafe fn write_volatile < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
